scope: Character-project worktree creation and project-related top-level F: locations. This does not attribute other projects or scan their contents.

covered: ordinary and sparse checkout in the managed directory
existing or dangling junction at the intended target
directory changed after revision resolution or after initial sparse worktree creation
recovery using the ordinary path after the fixture redirect is removed
regression.environment: Windows, local Git, real directory junctions inside the project fixture

knownLimits: Pre-write checks at each stage. An external process modifying paths simultaneously during a filesystem operation is outside these tests.
